svg.text: PR #2207 · Store linked portal connections on the home portal
A linked account had nowhere to live, so a second device could not know it existed.
portal_connections syncs metadata per (origin, remote user); credentials stay on device.
BEFORE
AFTER
users + user_identities
The home only knows its own account and the login
providers behind it.
No record of accounts on other portals
A link made on one browser is invisible on the next;
nothing to say "re-authorize cosmicfrontier here".
No shared notion of origin identity
"HTTPS://Work.Example:443/" and "https://work.example"
would be two different portals.
portal_connections (migration, no token column)
portal_origin, instance_id, remote_user_id, remote_email,
label, scope; UNIQUE (user_id, portal_origin, remote_user_id)
/api/portal-connections GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE
POST upserts; owner-only rows (404 for others); a
self-link and bad labels are 400; MAX 32 new links (409).
Unknown stored scope: row skipped, never guessed.
shared::urls::canonical_origin
url crate: equals the browser's origin serialization.
https only (http for loopback); rejects path, query,
userinfo, '*' and trailing dots. TokenScope::as_str/parse.
Home side only: no UI yet, and DELETE forgets the record without revoking the grant on the linked portal (the device holding the token does that).
